name: CYPROTERONE / ETHINYLESTRADIOL 2 /.035 MG 21 TABLETS
description: The combination of cyproterone/ethinylestradiol 2 mg/0.035 mg in a 21-tablet presentation is a hormonal medication with antiandrogenic and contraceptive effects. It is primarily used to treat severe skin conditions, such as androgen-dependent acne and hirsutism (excessive hair growth), in women. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
